images.prompt:
Create ONE intact AI-generated scientific conceptual figure, landscape 1536 x 1024, for a research software README. Premium Nature / Chemical Reviews graphical-abstract art direction: ivory background, sophisticated multi-color palette, dark readable typography, sharp scientific symbols, subtly dimensional physical objects and purposeful connecting paths. A single complete designed composition with a clearly populated lower caption band; no pasted collage, no repeated panel borders, no large blank bottom, no robot/brain/neon-circuit clichés, no invented performance numbers, no fake measured plots. English labels must be spelled correctly. Exact formulas should be clean and moderate in size, never decorative gibberish. Include footer "AI-generated conceptual illustration". These visuals explain scientific ideas and software responsibilities; they do not certify execution, physical accuracy or deployed integrations.
Palette: cobalt, deep navy, brushed gold, pale blue.
Title "AspenOps-Agent | EXECUTION WITH EVIDENCE". Visual centerpiece: a carefully drawn stylized process reactor and column surrounded by four clear functional regions, "Process Intent IR", "Validation & dry run", "License-bound worker pool", "Independent evidence". A separate thin band shows "Transport · engine · convergence · constraints · balances" as distinct checks. Show a source model protected beside a working case. Two physical callouts: "dn/dt = ṅ_in − ṅ_out + νrV" and "x_min ≤ x ≤ x_max". Label r "volumetric reaction rate". Bottom line "Declare → preflight → isolate → execute → verify". Small qualification "Real Aspen certification requires licensed evidence". Diagram is conceptual, not an exact engineering flowsheet.

Edit this scientific algorithm illustration. Preserve its exact layout, colors, all equations, labels and footer except ONE correction: replace the bottom-right label 'Completed engine run' with 'Scoped candidate'. The terminal box must read exactly 'Scoped candidate', because independent physical checks happen AFTER engine completion. Remove the golden check-mark seal inside that terminal box; use a neutral candidate-point symbol. No new formulas, claims, boxes or numbers. Keep everything else unchanged.

images.prompt:
Create ONE complete, publication-quality AI-generated scientific conceptual illustration for the seven-repository TSAO research ecosystem. Landscape 1536 x 1024. Premium Nature/Chemical Reviews graphical abstract aesthetic: ivory background, precise dark typography, dimensional molecular and continuum objects, refined colored ribbons, generous but purposeful spacing. It is a single intact composition, never a montage or collage, no empty lower strip.
Title verbatim: "TSAO | FROM LAWS TO EVIDENCE"
Subtitle: "Seven independent repositories · proposed scientific handoffs"
Organize a compact multiscale path through three gently curved levels, with seven precisely spelled repository names, each only once, and a short meaningful descriptor:
"OpenDeepMind_skill" — "Foundations & falsifiers", indigo/crimson
"TsaoSciResearcher" — "Questions & evidence", teal/amber
"TsaoDFT_skill" — "Electronic structure", plum/copper
"TsaoSciComputation" — "Numerics & verification", cyan/coral
"TSAO-PROCESSING-SKILL" — "Kinetics & balances", terracotta/deep blue
"AspenOps-Agent" — "Guarded process execution", cobalt/gold
"ResinDB-Pro-by-SunHJ" — "Materials data & screening", jade/coral
Connect with thin dotted colored ribbons to indicate proposed handoffs, not a deployed integrated runtime; a graceful feedback ribbon returns evidence to question formulation. Use physical objects that progress from electronic orbitals, to statistical ensembles and polymer coils, to a reactor/flowsheet, to curated material records. Avoid robot heads, brains, neon circuits and generic computer dashboards.
Include these six clean, modest mathematical callouts, accurately typeset and fully visible:
"Hψ = Eψ"
"Z = Σᵢ exp[−Eᵢ/(kᴮT)]"
"F = −kᴮT ln Z"
"k(T) = κ(kᴮT/h) exp[−ΔG‡/(RT)]"
"Σᵧ ≈ JΣₓJᵀ"
"p(θ|D) ∝ p(D|θ)p(θ)"
For kᴮ use a normal k with proper subscript B. Include tiny labels "canonical equilibrium", "molar activation free energy", "local uncertainty propagation" next to the relevant formulas. These formulas are scientific context, not claims of implemented solvers.
Bottom footer is fully designed and populated: "Units · provenance · uncertainty · independent validation" and "AI-generated conceptual illustration". No numeric performance claims or fake data curves. Careful short labels, readable mathematics and balanced visual hierarchy.
